rationale: The last candle shows an enormous volume spike (90,338 shares in one minute) pushing price to $50.00, which is 92.7% of today's range and just below the session high of $50.04 — this looks like a climactic move rather than a sustainable breakout. With no news catalyst to explain the volume surge and price already extended well above the 9-EMA ($49.65) and near the day's high, both long (chasing exhaustion) and short (fighting momentum with unclear catalyst) carry poor risk/reward. The spread is tight but the setup lacks a clean mechanical edge in either direction.
